payload.rebuttal: fixed: The witness checked fold_task(te2_key, [])'s effect only through regate(te2), which reads the regates table by first resolving record_key from the tasks row. fold_task always deletes the task row too, so regate(te2) returned None whether or not the regates delete ran, and the probe that removed the DELETE FROM regates line survived undetected. I added an assertion that reads the regates table directly with a raw sqlite3 connection after fold_task(te2_key, []), checking that only TE-1's task_key remains. I confirmed this change by manually re-applying the exact wrong version from the spec and watching the new assertion fail, then reverted that mutant and reran the full test, which passes.
